# Who the Model Is Being {#sec-who-the-model-is}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Kills: "the AI has a personality" — a system prompt is just text in
the request.

Installs: system prompts, personality bots, the pirate in a box.
Working build: two personalities from the same model, switched by one
string; the reader reuses a bot with `return_usage=True` to watch what
the instruction costs in tokens.
:::
